environment.tool: manual audit of the tag source + live compiled binary; scripted peer emitting exact response bytes, hexdump of client output

findings.description: The response parser marks code<200 as bad, so a 100/103/101/199 from the upstream is a proxy error rather than a forward. A backend that answers 100-continue style is unusable through this proxy. Precondition: any upstream that emits an interim response.
findings.title: Every 1xx is rejected outright: 23 of 23 interim shapes returned 502 and no interim head ever reaches the client

limitations: All RCE is on the upstream host
methods: Read the release source from the tag
Diffed the release source against the staged copy (identical)
Control response first on the same config
Scripted peer emitted one interim shape per path
Captured client bytes as hex and diffed against the control
Sent a follow-up request on the same connection

author_attested: analysis metadata reconstructed after the run
verified: release tag resolves to the submitted source
source SHA-256 and report and evidence hashes

scope: release/000002 of run 29d05850, round 9 lane I: the interim (1xx) upstream response state machine.
